mapper.insert: insert into media_favorite (owner_key, kind, target_id, album_id, seq, content_hash) select #{ownerKey}, #{kind}, #{targetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{albumId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{seq,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{contentHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR} from dual where not exists (select 1 from media_favorite where )
mapper.update: update media_favorite set created_at = current_timestamp(3), content_hash = coalesce(#{contentHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, content_hash) where
mapper.select: select f.kind, coalesce(v.id, f.target_id) as target_id, coalesce(p.album_id, f.album_id) as album_id, coalesce(p.seq, f.seq) as seq, f.created_at as happened_at, coalesce(v.title, a.title) as title from media_favorite f left join media_video v on f.kind = 'video' and ((f.content_hash is not null and v.content_hash = f.content_hash) or (f.content_hash is null and v.id = f.target_id)) left join media_photo p on f.kind = 'photo' and p.id = (select p2.id from media_photo p2 where (f.content_hash is not null and p2.content_hash = f.content_hash) or (f.content_hash is null and p2.album_id = f.album_id and p2.seq = f.seq) order by p2.album_id asc, p2.seq asc, p2.id asc limit 1) left join media_album a on a.id = coalesce(p.album_id, f.album_id) where f.owner_key = #{ownerKey} order by f.created_at desc, f.id desc limit #{limit}
select count(*) from media_favorite where owner_key = #{ownerKey} and kind = #{kind}
mapper.delete: delete from media_favorite where owner_key = #{ownerKey} and id not in (select id from ( select id from media_favorite where owner_key = #{ownerKey} order by created_at desc, id desc limit #{keep}) k)
